title: Nonnegativity of the Bernoulli weight
statement: Let $p \in \bbr$ satisfy $0 \le p \le 1$, and let $\rho$ be a restriction on $n$ variables, with $f$ of its variables left free. Then its Bernoulli weight $p^{f}\,\bigl(\tfrac{1-p}{2}\bigr)^{\,n - f}$ is nonnegative.
replaced:
If $0 \le p \le 1$, then for every restriction $\rho$ the weight
$\mathrm{bernoulliRestrWeight}(p,\rho)$ is nonnegative.
